parts.role: 16-bit SPI SAR converter, external VREF, offset/gain/INL specified as MAXIMA (IB grade) - see decision log. Price confirms architect's ~$12.39 quote exactly.
parts.risk_note: SINGLE-SOURCE, no genuine alternate. The datasheet's own pin-compatible family (ADS7816/7822/7826/7827/7829/ADS8320/ADS8325) is mechanically drop-in but electrically inferior - mostly 12-bit with TYPICAL-only offset/gain specs - and none closes this board's 0.1% error budget (this is exactly why MCP3201 was overruled at P2). The plain ADS8326I grade (same pinout) is also disqualified: its offset/gain spec is 3x looser and spends 96% of the 25 C RSS budget alone (recorded decision, P2). ADS8326IB is therefore the only part that satisfies the requirement; treat stock (2304, 92x the 25-piece floor) as the only cushion.

alternates.note: A-grade fallback (0.04%/4ppm vs B-grade 0.02%/2ppm), $5.75 cheaper, 908 pcs stock (2.9x deeper than B). Still closes RSS (3.66/3.90 mV) but its worst-case sum (12.04 mV) just MISSES the 12 mV over-temperature target the B grade clears at 10.29 mV - recorded fallback only if B stock lapses before order.

parts.role: 2.048V series voltage reference, B grade (0.02% initial, 2ppm/C max), feeds converter VREF only. VDO and load-cap window RE-VERIFIED this session against the current datasheet - see SUMMARY verification item 1.
parts.reject_note: CLONE REJECTED: LCSC also lists ADR4520ARZ-R7(TOKMAS) (brand Tokmas, ~$1.06) under a near-identical MPN. Its own attributes disagree with the genuine ADI part on supply range (2.8-40V vs ADI's 3-15V), output current (20mA vs 10mA) and tempco (8ppm/C vs ADI's 4ppm/C for A-grade) - not a drop-in, not used.

alternates.note: Same SOT-23-5 footprint. 30x lower drift (0.05 vs 5 uV/C) but REJECTED for this converter/rate combination at ANY legal DCLOCK - see SUMMARY verification item 2: even the slowest fDCLOCK that still sustains 10kSa/s (~220kHz) only stretches t_acq to ~20.5us, and OPA333's own measured settling curve needs ~40-55us to this board's ~7.6ppm target. Not a DCLOCK-tuning fix. Stock 8380, deepest of any buffer candidate; kept as the documented second source.

parts.role: Unity-gain follower, CMOS RRIO, buffers the 240 kohm attenuator Thevenin into the SAR's switched-cap input. Baseline per blocks.md s8.3/s8.4 and state.json decisions #31/#46 (OPA333 fails settling at t_acq=9us on two independent legs).
Attenuator string, ONE part in all five positions (R1-R5), 3:2 tap. This is the board's accuracy bottleneck (blocks.md s3.2/s3.3). 25 pieces needed at qty 5; stock 6235 = 249x the 125-piece floor.
parts.package_note: PACKAGE DEVIATION from the P2 research assumption (0603): the 0603 row at this exact grade (PTFR0603Q200KN9, C53099873, same stock 4150, same price ~$0.60) returns an EMPTY datasheet/url field on live search - unfetchable, so unverified per this role's own rule. The 0805 row (C23067436) is electrically identical (same RESI PTFR-Q series, same 0.02%/10ppm spec) with a live, fetchable datasheet and deeper stock. Purely mechanical (0805 vs 0603 footprint); placement corridors are already specified at 3-5mm width so this does not tighten anything. Flagged for P4/P6 footprint choice.

parts.role: ADC input isolation resistor, provisional mid-range pick inside the 20-100 ohm window sheets.md states. NOT a final value - the P8 sim benches (acquisition-settling, buffer-stability) set the real number; Basic-tier 1% E96 stock is dense across that whole range so a resim-driven value change is a like-for-like swap, not a sourcing risk.
Converter rail-entry isolation resistor, 10 ohm class per the ADS8326's own recommended application circuit (figs 44/45).
Bulk reservoir cap at the J2 rail entry.
parts.dielectric_note: sheets.md calls X7R; no Basic X7R 10uF/0805 row was live at search time so this is X5R (Basic, deep-stocked). X5R vs X7R only matters for capacitance-vs-temperature stability, not for a bulk DC reservoir cap holding a rail supplied at 3.135-3.465V well under its 25V rating - electrically equivalent here.

parts.role: Converter VDD_ADC decoupling, smaller cap closest to the pin, ahead of C8.
Converter REF-pin charge reservoir, 47uF class per the ADS8326's reference-input section. Sits inside the ADR4520's verified 1-100uF stable window (see SUMMARY item 1).
parts.esr_note: X7R ceramic MLCC, not the tantalum ADS8326 fig 42 shows as an example - ceramic has LOWER ESR than tantalum at this value/frequency and no tantalum wear-out/short-fail mode, and the reference's stability window (series-voltage-reference-output-cap-window record) is a value+ESR window, not a dielectric-technology requirement. 16V rating against a 2.048V operating point keeps ceramic DC-bias capacitance derating negligible.

parts.role: Reference IN-pin bypass (same part as C2/C6).

MANDATORY reference output/compensation cap. 2.2uF gives margin above the ADR4520's verified 1uF stability-window floor (see SUMMARY item 1) even after ceramic DC-bias derating at 2.048V on a 10V-rated part. NOT a DNP candidate.
Buffer (U3) supply-pin bypass, placed close across V+/V- per the precision-buffer-pin-decoupling knowledge record (same part as C2/C4).

ADC input charge-bucket cap at U1 +IN, C0G/NP0 as sheets.md requires (no DC-bias/temperature drift, unlike X7R). 1nF is inside the 1-2.2nF window and above the 20xC_SH=960pF floor; exact value is P8 sim territory alongside R6.
Converter VDD_ADC bulk cap, behind R7 (same part as C1; same X5R-for-X7R substitution rationale).

alternates.note: Same form factor, 24A/250V, stock 54315 - functionally interchangeable second source.

parts.role: J1 analog input, 2-pole 5.08mm THT screw terminal, fixed one-piece block (not the pluggable 2-part style).
J2 host header, 6-pin single-row 2.54mm male THT, pin order +3V3/GND/CS/SCLK/DOUT/GND per sheets.md.
parts.risk_note: No datasheet URL on this generic pin-header listing (common for commodity THT headers - mechanical part, no electrical spec at risk). Extended tier but stock is 14.6x the 25-piece floor at qty1 pricing already near the volume-break floor.
